name: Heaven Forbid
source:
Lilis and Eva have crossed over suddenly to the afterlife. Still, they're full of hope when they arrive at paradise. What they don't expect is the series of riddles that soon follows -- nine trials for heaven's nine tiers. In the end, who will be the last one standing? 

[From [url=https://orcamartiangames.itch.io/heaven-forbid]itch.io[/url]]
